rounds.text: Luxury Time Ltd faces significant operational headwinds that undermine its reported profitability. While the company reports rising profits, the cash conversion ratio is a concerning 0.14x, indicating that earnings are not being effectively translated into actual cash flow [E23]. This disconnect is further evidenced by the fact that operating cash flow represents only 39% of operating profit [E26]. The company’s efficiency is deteriorating, as evidenced by debtor days ballooning from 51.0 to 69.8 days and working capital requirements surging from 89.2 to 129 days [E42, E43]. Stagnant growth is a major risk, with compounded sales growth at 0% over the trailing twelve months [E15]. Institutional confidence is clearly waning, as evidenced by a sharp reduction in holdings by both foreign and domestic institutions, resulting in a negative money flow signal [E32, E33, E34]. Conceded: [E1, E6, E8, E9, E10, E16, E17, E27, E35, E36].
